info.name: Poly Score
info.summary: Track the player score of all your games
info.description: **Poly Score** is a score-tracking app for games for [Nextcloud](https://nextcloud.com/). It is designed to make keeping track of points easy and flexible. Organize matches by game and create reusable rulesets. Configure starting points, scoring direction, winning conditions, and maximum rounds. Use specialized scoring inputs and automatic calculations for supported games.
info.author: Christian Grubert
